summary: Marathi small-ads half page under news: a 'Sakal TODAY' strip with a gradient logo, Marathi category labels in pale blue outlined tags, ten narrow columns of Devanagari liners, and small boxed displays with yellow and red fills. A booking-service banner covers part of the image.

frame.masthead: Strip with the Marathi 'small ads' label, the paper's logo and a pink-to-purple gradient TODAY, plus booking phone numbers.

headers.notes: Pale blue fill with a thin dark outline; two-line Marathi labels. Lighter than Lokmat's or Eenadu's heads.

units.notes: Bold first words, Devanagari numerals for phones in some ads, Latin in others.

units.example: NPAV PC, Laptop Tablet, Mobile सुरक्षा
units.notes: Yellow/red/green fills, English and Marathi mixed, rotated text in one box.
Thin-ruled box around a single liner (paid upgrade).

notes: Ads2Publish overlay hides a band of the page.
Calmest of the Indian colour pages; close to Lokmat Goa (cl-021) in structure.
